svg.text: Every transcriptomics result in this course carries an unstated assumption. Here it is, measured.
some transcripts are translated 100× more efficiently than others
minutes to days — a stable protein accumulates from little mRNA
phosphorylation, cleavage, glycosylation change function, not amount
secreted, membrane-bound, or nuclear — RNA-seq cannot tell
ubiquitin–proteasome removes exactly what you were measuring
Drugs act on proteins. Assays measure proteins.
💡 The correlation is not "bad" — it is the amount of regulation that RNA-seq structurally cannot see. That gap is what W9–W10 measure.
